requirements.details: The diploma lists two intakes, in June and October.

source.title: Sunway University · Diploma in Nursing · entry requirements

requirements.label: Age at entry
requirements.details: Applicants must be at least 18 when the programme starts.

source.title: Sunway University · Bachelor of Nursing (Honours) · entry requirements

requirements.label: Interview and medical assessment
requirements.details: Applicants must pass both an interview and a medical check-up.

source.title: Sunway University · Bachelor of Nursing (Honours) · entry requirements

requirements.details: Submit the degree application to the Bachelor of Nursing programme leader listed on the linked course page.

source.title: Sunway University · Bachelor of Nursing (Honours) · entry requirements

requirements.label: Nursing diploma application
requirements.details: Submit the diploma application to the Diploma in Nursing programme leader listed on the linked course page.

source.title: Sunway University · Diploma in Nursing · entry requirements

requirements.label: A levels for Nursing
requirements.details: Present at least three A-level subjects at grade C or above.

source.title: Sunway University · Bachelor of Nursing (Honours) · entry requirements

requirements.label: Australian matriculation
requirements.details: The Nursing degree lists an ATAR of 65.

source.title: Sunway University · Bachelor of Nursing (Honours) · entry requirements

requirements.label: Canadian matriculation
requirements.details: The Nursing degree lists 65% for Canadian matriculation.

source.title: Sunway University · Bachelor of Nursing (Honours) · entry requirements

requirements.label: Monash University Foundation Year
requirements.details: The Nursing degree lists 65% for the Monash foundation year.

source.title: Sunway University · Bachelor of Nursing (Honours) · entry requirements

requirements.label: STPM entry
requirements.details: Pass STPM with a CGPA of at least 2.00.

source.title: Sunway University · Bachelor of Nursing (Honours) · entry requirements

requirements.label: UEC grades with SPM credits
requirements.details: Earn B6 or better in each of five UEC subjects and three SPM credits: Bahasa Melayu, elementary, additional or modern mathematics, and one science. The science may be general science, biology, chemistry, physics, applied science or additional science.

source.title: Sunway University · Bachelor of Nursing (Honours) · entry requirements

requirements.label: Registered nurse entry
requirements.details: A nursing diploma from an MQA-recognised institution must carry a CGPA of at least 2.50. Also provide a current Annual Practicing Certificate or Retention of Name from the Malaysian Nursing Board.

source.title: Sunway University · Bachelor of Nursing (Honours) · entry requirements

requirements.label: Other diploma route
requirements.details: Another diploma can support admission with CGPA 2.50 or above. No credit transfers on this route.

source.title: Sunway University · Bachelor of Nursing (Honours) · entry requirements

requirements.label: English proficiency for Nursing
requirements.details: Meet one threshold: MUET Band 3, IELTS 5.5, TOEFL 453 paper / 133 computer / 46 internet, or Pearson 51. Sunway also accepts 160 in Cambridge A2 Key, B1 Preliminary, B2 First, C1 Advanced, C2 Proficiency or Linguaskill, or 200 in OET.

source.title: Sunway University · Bachelor of Nursing (Honours) · entry requirements

requirements.label: A-level subjects for Biomedicine
requirements.details: Two subjects at grade D or higher must come from the groups biology, physics/mathematics and chemistry.

source.title: Sunway University · Bachelor of Science (Honours) Biomedicine · entry requirements

requirements.label: Pre-university science subjects
requirements.details: Present two principal passes from biology, physics/mathematics and chemistry at STPM, pre-university or matriculation level.

source.title: Sunway University · Bachelor of Science (Honours) Biomedicine · entry requirements

requirements.label: Science and technology foundation
requirements.details: Entry through Sunway’s Foundation in Science and Technology requires CGPA 2.30.

source.title: Sunway University · Bachelor of Science (Honours) Biomedicine · entry requirements

requirements.label: English qualification alternatives
requirements.details: Accepted results include IELTS 6.0 or equivalent, MUET Band 4, SPM English B+, UEC English B4 or O-level English (1119) B3.

source.title: Sunway University · Bachelor of Science (Honours) Biomedicine · entry requirements

requirements.label: A-level points for Psychology
requirements.details: Earn a minimum of 12 points on the university’s A-level scale.

source.title: Sunway University · Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Psychology · entry requirements

requirements.label: UEC subjects for Psychology
requirements.details: Five B-grade subjects must total 26 UEC points or fewer and include mathematics and one science.

source.title: Sunway University · Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Psychology · entry requirements

requirements.label: School mathematics and science
requirements.details: Earn a credit in mathematics and one science at SPM or an equivalent level.

source.title: Sunway University · Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Psychology · entry requirements

requirements.label: English qualification alternatives
requirements.details: Accepted results include IELTS 6.0 or equivalent, MUET Band 5, SPM English B3, UEC English B4 or O-level English (1119) B3.

source.title: Sunway University · Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Psychology · entry requirements

requirements.label: School credits and published waiver
requirements.details: Present three SPM or equivalent credits in mathematics, one science and one other subject. Sunway allows the SPM credit requirement to be waived for equivalent or higher pre-university grades.

source.title: Sunway University · BSc (Hons) Medical Biotechnology · entry requirements

requirements.label: Nursing diploma English evidence
requirements.details: Sunway lists IELTS 5.5, TOEFL 515 paper / 215 computer / 80 internet, Cambridge Advanced or Proficiency English, and Pearson PTE. Its international entry route requires one of these qualifications. No Cambridge or PTE score is given.

source.title: Sunway University · Diploma in Nursing · entry requirements

requirements.label: Alternative diploma qualifications
requirements.details: An overseas alternative must be recognised by MQA as equivalent to SPM. Sunway assesses applicants without a standard qualification individually.

source.title: Sunway University · Diploma in Nursing · entry requirements

requirements.label: Interview and health assessment
requirements.details: Attend the interview and pass the medical examination.

source.title: Sunway University · Diploma in Nursing · entry requirements

requirements.label: Medical certification for nursing training
requirements.details: A registered medical practitioner must certify fitness within one month of starting the diploma. The published entry policy lists serious physical or mental illness, serious communicable disease and physical or sensory limitations that hinder nursing dexterity as disqualifying conditions.

source.title: Sunway University · Diploma in Nursing · entry requirements

requirements.label: A-level grades and subject combination
requirements.details: Accepted combinations are ABC, AAC or BBB in biology, chemistry and either physics or mathematics.

source.title: Sunway University · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · entry requirements

requirements.label: STPM for Medicine
requirements.details: Achieve CGPA 3.00 and grades BBB, ABC or AAC in biology, chemistry and either physics or mathematics.

source.title: Sunway University · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · entry requirements

requirements.label: School grades for the designated routes
requirements.details: IB Diploma, Sunway Foundation in Science and Technology, Australian matriculation, Canadian International Matriculation Programme and Monash foundation-year applicants need five Bs at SPM, O-level or equivalent: biology, chemistry, physics, mathematics or additional mathematics, and one other subject.

source.title: Sunway University · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · entry requirements

requirements.label: Science and technology foundation for Medicine
requirements.details: Earn CGPA 3.00, with at least C in biology, chemistry and either physics or mathematics.

source.title: Sunway University · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · entry requirements

requirements.label: Australian matriculation for Medicine
requirements.details: Achieve ATAR 80 including biology, chemistry and either physics or mathematics, or an aggregate equivalent to B in those three subjects.

source.title: Sunway University · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · entry requirements

requirements.label: Canadian International Matriculation Programme
requirements.details: Achieve an aggregate of 80% over six subjects and an average of 80% in biology, chemistry and either physics or mathematics.

source.title: Sunway University · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · entry requirements

requirements.label: Monash University Foundation Year
requirements.details: Achieve 80% including biology, chemistry and either physics or mathematics.

source.title: Sunway University · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · entry requirements

requirements.label: UEC for Medicine
requirements.details: Earn B4 in each of five subjects: biology, chemistry, physics, mathematics or Advanced Mathematics I, and Advanced Mathematics or Advanced Mathematics II.

source.title: Sunway University · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · entry requirements

requirements.label: English evidence for Medicine
requirements.details: Options include MUET Band 4, IELTS 6.0 or equivalent, SPM English B+, O-level English (1119) credit, UEC English B4, or an English-medium pre-university, diploma, foundation or equivalent programme.

source.title: Sunway University · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · entry requirements

requirements.details: Malaysian applicants need an SPM credit in Bahasa Melayu or grade C at SVM.

requirements.label: English qualification for registration
requirements.details: Malaysian applicants whose entry qualification was taught in a language other than English need MUET or an international English proficiency qualification to register.

source.title: Sunway University · Bachelor of Science (Honours) Biomedicine · entry requirements

requirements.label: Malaysian SPM route
requirements.details: Earn SPM credits in Bahasa Melayu, mathematics and one science, and pass English and a further subject.

source.title: Sunway University · Diploma in Nursing · entry requirements

requirements.label: Malaysian O-level route
requirements.details: Earn five O-level credits including English, mathematics and one science. Local O-level applicants must also hold a credit in Malay as a first language.

source.title: Sunway University · Diploma in Nursing · entry requirements

requirements.label: Malaysian UEC route
requirements.details: Present five B grades including English, mathematics and one science, plus a Bahasa Melayu credit for local UEC applicants.

source.title: Sunway University · Diploma in Nursing · entry requirements

requirements.label: School English evidence
requirements.details: The general English table lists an SPM English credit as a further option. Overseas applicants should use the international English qualification route.

source.title: Sunway University · Diploma in Nursing · entry requirements

profiles.notes: Course-specific health and medical admissions at Sunway University.

requirements.label: International school grades
requirements.details: Pass SPM or its equivalent with at least C in each of five subjects: mathematics (elementary, additional or modern), one of science, biology, chemistry, physics or applied science, and three other subjects.

source.title: Sunway University · Diploma in Nursing · entry requirements

requirements.label: Spoken Bahasa Melayu
requirements.details: International diploma applicants must be able to converse in Bahasa Melayu.
